description: This file provides TypeScript type definitions for the Moment.js library, including function signatures, types, interfaces, classes, and constants used in the library for date and time manipulation.

methods.name: declare function moment(inp?: moment.MomentInput, strict?: boolean): moment.Moment; moment
methods.description: Main function to create a Moment object, with overloads for different parameter combinations representing different parsing options.

methods.name: utc
methods.description: Creates a Moment object in UTC mode, with overloads for strict parsing and custom formats.

methods.name: unix
methods.description: Creates a Moment object from a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: invalid
methods.description: Creates an invalid Moment object, optionally with specific parsing flags.

methods.name: isMoment
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a Moment instance.

methods.name: isDate
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a native JavaScript Date.

methods.name: isDuration
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a Duration instance.

methods.name: lang
methods.description: Deprecated function for locale management, replaced by locale.

methods.name: locale
methods.description: Gets or sets the current locale, can accept locale strings, arrays, or specification objects.

methods.name: localeData
methods.description: Returns locale data for a given locale key.

methods.name: duration
methods.description: Creates a Duration object from various input formats.

methods.name: parseZone
methods.description: Parses a Moment object considering time zone information.

methods.name: months
methods.description: Gets an array of month names or a specific month name, with optional formatting.

methods.name: monthsShort
methods.description: Gets short month names.

methods.name: weekdays
methods.description: Gets an array of weekday names.

methods.name: weekdaysShort
methods.description: Gets an array of short weekday names.

methods.name: weekdaysMin
methods.description: Gets an array of minimal weekday names.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum of given moments.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum of given moments.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp in milliseconds.

methods.name: defineLocale
methods.description: Defines a new locale with given specifications.

methods.name: updateLocale
methods.description: Updates an existing locale.

methods.name: locales
methods.description: Returns an array of available locale keys.

methods.name: normalizeUnits
methods.description: Normalizes various unit representations to standard units.

methods.name: relativeTimeThreshold
methods.description: Gets or sets the threshold for relative time formatting.

methods.name: relativeTimeRounding
methods.description: Gets or sets the rounding function for relative time calculations.

methods.name: calendarFormat
methods.description: Determines format for calendar display based on current and reference moments.

methods.name: parseTwoDigitYear
methods.description: Parses a two-digit year into a four-digit year.

ctags.name: moment
ctags.pattern: /^declare function moment(inp?: moment.MomentInput, strict?: boolean): moment.Moment;$/
